$comment: Phase A pinned Hermez ptau per S2-7 §7.1 + PHASE-PLAN §A item A12. DEV-MODE ONLY — partner-pilot deployments REQUIRE the M7 production ceremony.

powersOfTau28_hez_final_15.ptau.comment: Covers circuits ≤ 2^15 constraints (equality + non_equality fit). Range + set_membership may NOT fit — Phase C may re-pin to _17 per-circuit.

powersOfTau28_hez_final_17.ptau.comment: Covers all 4 leaf circuits + aggregate-8-leaves expected budget. Default for partner-pilot if Phase C constraint counts exceed _15 ceiling.

phase_c_actual_consumed.$comment: Phase C ran in sandbox-no-network (getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND storage.googleapis.com); pinned Hermez ptau was unreachable at build time. Phase C generated a local-dev fallback ptau15 for deterministic Phase C-E execution. This is DEV-MODE ONLY — partner traffic MUST consume the M7-ceremony-verified pinned ptau, not this local-dev artifact.
phase_c_actual_consumed.divergence_reason: Sandbox has no outbound network access; pinned Hermez ptau (powersOfTau28_hez_final_15.ptau) unreachable. Phase C generated a deterministic local-dev fallback to unblock Phase C-E execution.
phase_c_actual_consumed.production_fetch_plan: M7 production ceremony fetches the pinned Hermez ptau from storage.googleapis.com (or the canonical snarkjs mirror), verifies sha256 against the canonical value, then re-runs the circuit setup pipeline with the verified ptau. The result replaces the Phase C local-dev zkey + verification_key artifacts before partner-pilot.
phase_c_actual_consumed.warning: DEV-MODE ONLY — not for partner traffic

phase_c_runtime_pin.$comment: Phase C `pnpm run setup:circuits` MUST verify the sha256 of the downloaded ptau before consuming. The M7 ceremony fills in the verified Hermez sha256 fields above (currently TBD-M7-CEREMONY-VERIFIES). The phase_c_actual_consumed block above captures the actual local-dev artifact Phase C consumed in sandbox.

ceremony_dev_mode_warning: This pinned ptau set is DEV-MODE ONLY. Partner-pilot deployments require the M7 production ceremony per S2-7 §7.1 (lines 704-716). Stage 3 must pin the specific Powers-of-Tau transcript, contribution hash chain, proving library, verifier generator, and ceremony verification command in S2-3/S2-6 BEFORE shipping to a partner.
